figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicative expression depicting the orderly movement of countless ants
example_sentences_in_english: People are pouring into the meeting in droves.
Buyers are swarming the market like ants.
note: This idiom draws from everyday observation of ant behavior in Bengali rural life.
